description: Install a starter guardrail pack — sensible hard/soft rules (protect main, block rm -rf, no prod data destruction, no curl|sh, flag secrets) — and emit them to every tool's companion files. Zero-config protection on day one. Pass force=true to overwrite same-named rules. Pair with `agent-memory install-hooks` so hard rules actually block tool calls.

force.description: Overwrite existing starter rules. Default false.

name: init
